description.en: "Archangel ", which appears and plays an active role in " Mobile Suit Gundam SEED " and " Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny", is now available in EXModel with limited specifications. The entire ship is coated with smoke gray plating. By replacing parts, it is possible to reproduce the deployment of weapons and MS catapult. Comes with dedicated display stand
